entities.summary: Vladimer Chachibaia is a Georgian lieutenant general and politician who has served as the Advisor to the Prime Minister of Georgia on Defense and Security Affairs since 2023. He previously serves as the Chief of Georgian Defense Forces from 20 December 2018 to 1 July 2020 and was a member of Parliament of Georgia from 11 December 2020 to 24 March 2023. His previous top commanding positions included being the Chief of Joint Staff and Chief of General Staff of the Georgian Armed Forces.
